chunks: So be not grieved by what they say. We certainly know what they hide and disclose.
ai.seo_question: What does God know about the disbelievers' secrets and public speech in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Yaseen, this verse provides divine consolation to the Prophet (SAWW) amidst the ridicule of the Quraish, emphasizing that God’s omniscience encompasses both the hidden doubts and the public assertions of the disbelievers. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a source of spiritual resilience, reminding believers that divine awareness transcends human perception, thereby validating the Prophet’s mission despite external opposition.
